$meta.name: TMT progress blueprints (machine-readable)
$meta.source: TMT-Reference/09-Layer-Design-Patterns.md, §3 Progress blueprints (§3.1 small, §3.2 medium, §3.3 large); cross-refs to §2 patterns P1–P17 and §5 anti-patterns A1–A10
$meta.usage: The interview's SCALE answer selects exactly one blueprint. Copy its parameters into the design brief. Every deviation must be written down in the brief with a reason (SKILL.md Stage 2).

rows.note: contiguity is mandatory (anti-pattern A2: skipped row numbers break tree rendering)

sideLayers.rewards: flat multipliers + exactly one automation grant

rowPlan.source: 09 §3.1 row0; opener is P1 (Normal(0.5) Opener), requires mode 10

rowPlan.unlockTrigger: row-0 layer's upgrade 15 (the 'exit ticket' upgrade, P7)

rowPlan.special: canBuyMax() gated behind an upgrade is the standard floor-completion reward

order.threshold: milestone at ~30x past the row-0 unlock point

automationLadder.crossLayerGrants: higher layers' milestones automate lower layers

sideLayers.rewards: alternate automation path (P11 backfill with !hasUpgrade/!hasMilestone guards)

sideLayers.pattern: P13 side-layer dashboard fed by main layers

rowPlan.role: ANCHOR LAYER — every later layer must add at least one gainMult() line boosting it (P10; anti-pattern A7 orphaned opener)

automation.ladder: full ladder per branch, cross-layer grants
automation.note: granting the three flags together as one package is the standard endgame QoL move (P4)

large.label: Large game — 25+ layers, 50+ hours

rows.last: 10+ visible rows (Mario Maker: 20 rows x 1–4 layers; Mining: spaced rows 101/201/…)

structure.phases: theme-driven phases (P14): currency types change per phase
structure.hubAndSpoke: at least one hub-and-spoke region (Incrementreeverse p-hub pattern)

automation.ladderSpacing: x2 per step, full ladder per layer (P4)
automation.doResetFreePass: doReset returns undefined when resettingLayer row >= N, so late phases never wipe early phases (P9)

softcaps.policy: layered caps on every long-lived currency (P12 defense-in-depth)
softcaps.capDelayUpgrades: 'raise the cap' upgrades sold 2–3 rows later (Mario Maker softcap upgrade pattern)

qol: hotkey on every resettable layer (Shift+letter variant for the second layer of the same row)

selectionRules.scaleToBlueprint: interview Q2 answer maps 1:1 to blueprints.small|medium|large — do not mix blueprints or improvise parameters
selectionRules.ceilingOverride: if interview Q3 says the theme has natural ceilings, per 09 §4 'when defaults must move': hard-cap capped currencies via softcap(x, cap, 0) and stop their ladder at the cap (Gaokao pattern, P8a)
selectionRules.idleOverride: if interview Q4 says idle-first, prefer log/custom gains (P8b Incrementreeverse pattern) over sqrt resets and lengthen the automation ladder
selectionRules.shortScopeOverride: never compensate a short scope with many thin layers — density beats breadth (anti-pattern A4)
